id.meaning: Nonempty ASCII lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; no leading, trailing or consecutive hyphens; at most 64 bytes.

cartridge.meaning: The removed cartridge on success, containing id, title, url, guest_class and admin_only.

cartridgeCount.meaning: Number of registry entries after removal.

command.meaning: Command named in a handler error response.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Success or handler error signal. JSON extraction errors can occur before the handler and need not carry this field.
